== Biography ==
Elizabethe Glasgow was born in 1616. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1027|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Conynghame-2|Jonet Conynghame]]. She was baptized 15 Dec 1616 at High Church, Glasgow, Lanark, Scotland.<ref>Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950. MyHeritage.com [online database], accessed 2025. https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-8534702/elizabethe-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms. Christening: 15 Dec 1616 at High Church, Glasgow, Lanark, Scotland. Parents: Robert Glasgow and Jonet Conynghame.</ref><ref>"Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms," database, National Records of Scotland, ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] : accessed 13 May 2025), Elizabethe Glasgow born or baptised on 15 Dec 1616, daughter of Robert Glasgow & Jonet Conynghame, in Glasgow, Lanarkshire, Scotland; citing Parish Number 644/1, Ref 10/208.</ref>
